reviews.title: So far, absolutely great!!!
reviews.comment: Saw reviews stating there was a smell to the fans and also a noise coming from the pump ? No smell and no noise! Just make sure your pump header/cpu fan header; whichever you use on your motherboard, is set to 12V in bios. The only thing I had an issue with initially, the first day I set it up, was noticing that the LCD screen itself would shut off after a certain amount of time. I reseated the cable that plugs into the USB motherboard header and haven’t had an issue with it since! I’ve used plenty of IDCooling products in the past and they have all been amazing thus far! CPU is running at a solid 26 Celsius and the fans for the radiator look and run great! This is definitely worth getting if you’re trying to budget. Edit: After a year, this thing is still running solid with no problems. I've been running the same settings since I got it and I am about to upgrade my pc entirely to future proof. Will see how it holds up once that's done.
reviews.author: Viz

reviews.title: The Best Budget AIO....Period!
reviews.comment: First off, I'd like to say that this AIO is very Aesthetic. Second, I have to say that the overall quality of the AIO is amazing, and it has killer value when it comes to performance per dollar. I am running a Ryzen 5 5600 with an RX 6700xt Reference card and while playing most high demanding games the CPU ran kind of hot with the stock AMD Wraith Cooler @ 85c - 90c which was a little high for my liking so I stumbled across the ID Cooling AIO and figured I would give it a shot cause at the amazing price with the LCD screen it seemed way worth it, and guess what.....I was not disappointed. My CPU now stays below 70c at 100% Utilization while playing The Finals and Star Citizen. As you can see in the video attached it cruises below 40c at Idle. Big Props to you ID Cooling for bringing us this amazing budget AIO.
reviews.author: Just a Friendly Neighbor

reviews.title: good led screen aio on a budget!
reviews.comment: i love this aio! it’s very cooling and made my pc run quieter, the gifs are also crystal clear and the software is easy to find and use :) two complaints tho, i wish the physical manual had better explanations of the wires, as i was slightly confused and honestly just guessed the right placements lol!! also i mounted the pump according to the placement of the text on the sticker, only for my sticker to have put on incorrectly and my pump was installed sideways 😓 nothing a little gif rotation website can’t fix tho! but overall very good for the price!!
reviews.author: Carol L Richards

reviews.title: Good Looks, Annoying Pump Noise
reviews.comment: The AIO looks nice and all. The pump, though? It's got this funny sound, kind of like a small washer. I tried getting a replacement, but the new one does the same damn thing. It wasn't that bad at first, but now you can really hear it. My computer's got its own little washing machine soundtrack.
reviews.author: Christian Boyd

reviews.title: Looks pretty darn cool!
reviews.comment: Had someone else installed it for me and it look sick in my PC! Love the LCD screen option and the fact you can load a gif onto it but there was one problem I faced while using it, when I turn my PC off the turn it on my LCD screen stopped working.. I unplugged my usb-j and replaced it and it seemed to work but only for 20 minutes before going dark again, searched all over the web to fix this problem and I found the solution! If you are having the exact same problem as i had then when you turn your PC off turn your PSU along with it then when turning on the PC turn on your PSU first the the PC, works every time! Thinking it's a software issue on the manufacturer part but will have to do this technique for now until they fix they're software other then that I'm loving this liquid cooler but if you don't want to have to turn off your PSU every time you turn off your PC I would recommend searching for another brand for a liquid cooler 😉
